description: Four signed 8-bit differences d_k=a_k-b_k clamped to [-128,127]. result[8k+:8]=two's complement of the clamped d_k. aux[3:0]=lanes that clamped, aux[7:4]=lanes where a_k<b_k. fault=any clamp.
hardware_advantage: Background/motion subtraction on 4 pixels per beat, with the sign and clamp flags produced in the same beat instead of a per-pixel compare loop.
provenance: original source authored in this workspace; no third-party RTL imported
qualification: engineering candidate; not certified production or side-channel protection
